quote: If any driver or operator of a motor vehicle drives or operates a motor vehicle at a speed so slow as to impede the forward movement of traffic proceeding immediately behind the driver or operator, the driver or operator shall: If the highway has two or more clearly marked lanes for traffic traveling in the direction in which the driver or operator is traveling, drive in the extreme right-hand lane except when necessary to pass other slowly moving vehicles.

activation.source_clause: If any driver or operator of a motor vehicle drives or operates a motor vehicle at a speed so slow as to impede the forward movement of traffic proceeding immediately behind the driver or operator

exceptions.source_clause: except when necessary to pass other slowly moving vehicles

judgment_calls_needed.note: Original follower movement and traffic context must be independently reviewed; closing speed is not a legal cutoff.
judgment_calls_needed.phrase: so slow as to impede the forward movement of traffic proceeding immediately behind

judgment_calls_needed.note: Original slower-vehicle behavior and passing context must be reviewed; an observed pass is not necessity.
judgment_calls_needed.phrase: necessary to pass other slowly moving vehicles

obligation.source_clause: If the highway has two or more clearly marked lanes for traffic traveling in the direction in which the driver or operator is traveling, drive in the extreme right-hand lane

timing.source_clause: while operating at the relevant slow speed on the highway
